plan.study: Is poor PAXG/ZEC performance parameter mismatch or evidence against the rules in these markets?
plan.frozen_parameter_range: 64 combinations per asset = 8 entry configurations x8 exit configurations. Center55/144, width31 unchanged, trigger0.4/1.2W, chase2/3W. PAXG activation0.3/2%, initial stop0.3/1%; ZEC activation1/2%, stop1/3%; giveback35/50%. Both directions remain.
plan.training: Train all64 on earliest3(PAXG)/4(ZEC) years. Per entry-only/exit-only/joint family take top3 plus baseline. Evaluate this union on next1year. In each family select highest validation return among its frozen top3 and baseline. No expansion.
plan.rules: After parameter selection, compare exactly six modes on original parameters AND the selected joint parameters: fixed stop/2ATR14/3ATR14 crossed with opposite confirmation1/2 closes. ATR uses Wilder TR incl previous-close gaps, signal-close ATR distance fixed at entry, never widened; profit protection unchanged. Confirmation affects only opposite-position signals; flat first entries unchanged. Stop/protection always active while waiting; opposite exit preserved even if too far to reverse.
plan.final_selection: Only validation ranks the original, entry-only, exit-only, joint, and their specified original/joint method variants. Fix overall validation winner, each anchor method winner, all comparison keys and six one-axis neighbors of joint parameters before reading remaining2years. Neighbor results diagnose fragility, cannot change selections.
plan.final: Evaluate every locked comparison+neighbor on full, final2years, each final year. Report all changes versus originals and same-anchor pairs. Do not promote the final-best to a new selected winner. Full-history values are explanatory, not a new optimization.
plan.limitation: All historical years were already examined in prior turns, and range design uses those diagnoses. Last2years are excluded from this round selection only, not a genuinely untouched final dataset. No assertion of eliminating overfitting or exhausting all parameters.
plan.stop_rule: One bounded study, no expansion after validation/final. Failed candidates stay visible. Preserve snapshots and every full trade trace.
plan.atr_engine_change: Add optional absolute stop-loss distance to project Intent/engine. When absent, legacy output must exactly match original frozen baseline report/trades/signals/equity. Original engine is saved in version041.
plan.provenance: Reuse exact project MarketDataService/KlineStore data hashes with650 warmup; observed gaps unchanged. All original files backed up.
